description: SuperPenguin provides AI spend intelligence by transforming opaque AI billing into actionable data. The platform allows engineering and finance teams to see exactly which customers, features, teams, models, and providers are driving AI costs. By opening the 'black box' of AI spend, organizations can gain full visibility into their operational expenses across various AI services.
